description: The actual result is an upright full-body man in a blue-green crossed-front Khuzait deel with woven bronze-gold knot/cloud trim at collar, sleeves and hem. A decorated brown sash and belt have round metal ornaments and hanging cords; cream inner sleeves, loose tan trousers and tall worn boots are visible. Both hands are visible. Plain blurred stone doorway and paving, no visible words, banner, armor, headgear or weapon.
